admission.justification: The default spans rail composition, exact-scope menu selection and mounted tests; a Worker default would direct the developer to the wrong seat.

applicability: The dashboard review chat column for a target with repository, master and leaf, and transitions to/from Operations task documents.
conditions: A matching hydrated task document or explicit pending/missing-task state is available.
An explainer target is forwarded through the existing shared RightRail.
exclusions: Native frame recovery/new-generation rules stay with the existing Paseo frame owner.
Ordinary taskless Projects Architect and document role discovery keep their own policy.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/reviewExplainerColumn.test.tsx::passes column.explainer through RightRail into DocumentChat so cold, open, finalized and planning targets select explainer/placeholder, never Worker; dashboard/src/cockpit/reviewExplainerColumn.test.tsx::keeps the exact same iframe DOM node and draft across Operations and Review page/phase switches; dashboard/src/explainer/model.test.ts::filters by exact repository, master and task path, excluding foreign seats with the same short id; source-location and unchanged-byte audit: helpers/frontend/source-drift-current-W9.json; no fresh test execution.

statement: A leaf review selects its explainer or its no-seat placeholder by default, never its Worker, and the header lists only the exact task’s chats with the explainer first while other pages retain their own document chat.
